title: The Boy Who Is the World’s Strongest Sorcerer Participates in a Large Scale Magic Battle Tournament
overview: Ray, Ariane, and Amelia form a team to participate in the Magicks War tournament. Now it's time to train!

title: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Dons a Mask... Again
overview: Ray trains Ariane, while Lieselotte trains Amelia. Ray's mom also wants Ariane to get ahead in love?!

title: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Keeps Winning With His Team
overview: Ray's team makes it to the finals of Magicks War, where they have to face Evi, Albert, and Lucas.

title: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer and His Friends Converse With Their Fists
overview: It's Lucas vs Ariane and Amelia, and Ray vs Evi and Albert! Neither side is backing down, who is going to win?

title: The Boy Who Is the World's Strongest Sorcerer Goes on a Date With That Girl in a Foreign Land
